scope: Bound ability inline facts, full reader, occupied-slot commands and input hints in the retained inventory ledger.
result: No actionable P1/P2 source defect found within the reviewed bound-ability changes. The separately observed Rain bullet-glyph defect is queued for narrow text-normalization TDD.
review_checks: Current selected slot is resolved through its current owned ActivatedAbilitiesPart each time. Empty and removed abilities return no stale prose.
Existing displacement, grimoire candidate and item/equipment modal branches retain priority. Ability facts remain neutral prose with no invented item subject or portrait.
Inline non-grimoire facts and the complete F1 reader reuse AbilityDetailsBuilder; its skill declarations and eligibility inspection do not learn, activate or pay for an ability.
Full details command exists only for an occupied ability slot and uses the existing one-shot reader request. It does not cast or rebind.
Inline non-grimoire body uses 18-pixel glyphs, 13 fitted lines and explicit truncation; complete text remains available in the reader.
Existing grimoire signature ink ends above the new full-details hint. The hint ends before Assign/Clear buttons. Keyboard F1 and connected-controller LT+RT labels use existing input mappings.
Only the selected non-grimoire ability builds its authoritative preview during an explicit repaint; no new idle repaint loop or new stale-result cache was introduced.

Eight bound-ability cases cover real registered En Garde/Lunge, an actual held LongSword, current cooldown, neutral reader facts, no paid action/binding/cooldown mutation, empty/removal counters, occupied/empty Commands and keyboard/pad hints.

native_evidence.executed_by: root only; this reviewer did not run Unity
